common.searchPeople: Search by name or mobile number
common.retainedShifts: {{message}}. These future shifts are still kept:
common.name: Name
api.modeUnconfirmed: Delivery mode is not confirmed. Try again shortly.
api.invalidResponse: The server response was not valid (HTTP {{status}}). Refresh and try again.
api.unavailable: The service did not respond normally (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later or check the service.
api.listIncomplete: Could not load the full list
api.listStalled: The list did not finish loading. Refresh and try again.
login.intro: Staff, sites, and rosters, from one workspace.
login.title: Sign in
nav.label: Main navigation
staff.mobileInvalid: The mobile number must include a country code, for example +85296644718
staff.optIn: This person has agreed to receive work notices
staff.optInHint: Confirm this once. The system records when and who confirmed it. Without this, WhatsApp will not be used for this person.
staff.linkFirst: Link this person to an active work site first
staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Keep contact details, availability, and work-site links up to date.
staff.importHelp: Required columns: name, mobile. Language is en or yue. If work-notice consent was given, set whatsapp_opt_in=true. Do not fill in a consent source.
csv.title: Import CSV
csv.limit: Up to 5,000 rows and 5 MB. Nothing is imported unless every row is valid.
site.name: Site name
site.voiceHint: Used only for English phone MP3s. The existing site name and address stay as they are. Leave blank if they are already in English.
site.title: Work sites
site.intro: Manage work sites and who can work there. Dates and times use Hong Kong time.
site.importHelp: Required columns: site_code, staff_mobile. Existing links are not created again.
site.linkHint: Select the staff allowed to work at this site.
users.title: Accounts and access
users.intro: Manage sign-in accounts and site access for workforce scheduling.
audit.title: Activity log
audit.intro: Changes you can access, and when they happened.
dispatch.status.submission_unknown: Submission result unknown. Do not resend.
dispatch.endAfterStart: The end time must be later than the start time
dispatch.timeHint: All dates and times are Hong Kong time
dispatch.deadlineHint: If you leave the deadline blank, the start time is used.
dispatch.chooseLinked: Choose staff linked to this site
dispatch.devHint: This only simulates replies. It does not place a real call or send WhatsApp.
dispatch.cancelBody: Accepted assignments are cancelled too, and a cancellation notice is sent.
dispatch.removeBody: Remove {{name}}'s slot and send a cancellation notice.
dispatch.acceptBody: Accept the shift for {{name}}. Remaining slots and shift conflicts are still checked.
dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.intro: Send work invitations and track each channel and confirmed slots.
dispatch.empty: No dispatches yet. Add a work site and link staff first.
roster.managedNotice: This shift is managed by a dispatch. To change the person, the time, or to cancel it, use the original dispatch.
roster.sameSlot: Choose open shifts in the same time slot
roster.title: Roster
roster.intro: View shifts and gaps in the work site's local time.
roster.empty: Add a work site to start scheduling.
roster.published: Published {{published}} shifts and queued notices for {{notified}} staff.
roster.publishBody: Publish this week's draft shifts and queue one notice for each staff member who can be reached on WhatsApp.
template.metaHint: After you submit it to Meta, wait for approval. Saving does not mean it can be sent immediately. This manages a plain-text BODY and the two reply buttons on an invitation.
template.variableHintAfter: . Enter sample values for Meta review.
template.name: Template name
template.mappingHint: Each language and purpose maps to its own Meta template. You can save the mapping first. Live sending requires an approved template whose positional parameters match.
template.deleteBody: This deletes {{name}} from the microservice and Meta. Confirm that no new notice still needs it.
settings.title: Channel settings
settings.intro: Manage connections, Cantonese and English templates, and phone audio. Scheduled invitations keep their original settings. New invitations use the new settings.
settings.secretSet: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.tokenHint: Token {{state}}. Enter a public HTTPS origin, for example https://example.ngrok-free.app, without /api. DTMF, call status, and recording paths are added automatically. Choose how audio is produced under Phone audio.
settings.keyHint: API key {{state}}. Enter the microservice origin without /v1. The secret is not sent back to the browser. You can turn on the live microservice and prepare templates first. Sending still checks that the template is approved.
settings.modeLocal: Generate a full MP3 locally (Cantonese / English)
settings.modeHint: Saving affects only newly sent jobs. Existing jobs and follow-up notices keep their original settings.
settings.enableBody: After you save, new invitations may place live calls or send WhatsApp. Confirm the recipients, templates, and staff languages. Existing mock jobs are not switched to live delivery.
speech.sharedIntro: The full audio uses a generic form of address. Staff on the same job and language share it. Individual names are not included.
speech.sayIntro: The call reads the invitation, confirmation, and cancellation in the employee's language. You do not upload a recording.
speech.editHint: You can change fixed wording, or use a homophone to correct pronunciation. System data and keypresses are locked and cannot be edited here.
speech.fixedCount: Fixed lines {{count}}/1,200 characters. Each line is limited to 400.
speech.sharedPreviewHint: This is a text preview. After you save, the dispatch draft prepares the MP3 automatically. You can also preview it.
speech.sayPreviewHint: This is a text preview. The spoken result still follows the Twilio call.
speech.saveHint: When you are done, use Save settings at the top of the page. New invitations use the new script. Invitations already sent, and their follow-ups, keep the original script.
speech.reloadHint: Reload channel settings to edit the script.
speech.systemDataHint: The site, address, and shift times are added by the system in Hong Kong time. If the shift crosses midnight, the end date is spoken. Press 1 to accept, 2 to decline, and 9 to hear it again.
speech.testHint: Set the language on the staff record, then check the address, numbers, and dates on a real call.
voice.localIntro: Cantonese uses VITS Cantonese. English uses Piper. Invitation audio is stored and reused by script. Confirmation, cancellation, and keypress prompts are shared across jobs.
voice.installed: Local speech is installed. Cantonese and English can be generated.
voice.missingEngine: Local speech is not installed. Ask an administrator to install the models on the server.
voice.autoHint: Missing MP3s are prepared automatically. You do not confirm them one by one. Preview and script edits are optional. The same content reuses stored audio.
voice.mixedHint: English phrases inside a Cantonese script are read with Piper, then saved in the same MP3. The two voices will sound different. Set how an English place name is spoken on the work site. Extra notes in an English notice must be in English.
voice.stillGenerating: This audio is still generating. Use Check voice again shortly to see the result.
voice.savedReuse: Audio saved. Later calls will reuse it.
voice.restored: Default script restored. Existing audio is reused when it still matches.
voice.previewOnly: {{label}} preview only. Calls still use each employee's language.
voice.unsupportedLocal: Local speech supports only Cantonese and English. Check the candidate's language.
voice.unsupported: This employee's language is not supported. Change the staff language and check again.
voice.previewOnlyReady: This language is for preview only and does not affect sending.
voice.autoReady: The system will prepare them. You can send when that finishes.
voice.ready: Audio for this language is ready.
voice.customized: This job uses an edited script. Matching content can still reuse the audio.
voice.incomplete: The last local generation did not finish. You can generate it again.
voice.scriptSaved: Script saved. The system will prepare new audio for this part. Other audio stays as it is.
voice.inviteIntro: Invitations generate a full MP3 automatically. Confirmation, cancellation, and keypress prompts share fixed audio. The same script is generated once and reused for every call. Press 1 to accept, 2 to decline, and 9 to hear it again.
voice.optionalHint: Preview and script edits are optional. This only prepares audio. Staff are contacted when you choose Send invitations.
voice.installFirst: Ask an administrator to install the local speech models on the server first.
voice.auditionHint: Changing the preview does not change the employee's language and does not place a call.
voice.staffReady: Audio for the employee's language is ready.
voice.needCandidates: The required languages appear after you add eligible candidates.
editor.saveStale: The script was saved, but the page did not refresh. Check the voice again, or keep editing and save once more.
editor.title: Edit script: {{label}}
editor.intro: This changes only this part of the voice for this job. Other audio is kept. The site, date, time, and keypresses are filled in by the system.
editor.fixedCount: Fixed lines {{count}}/1,200 characters. Each line is limited to 400 and cannot be entirely blank.
clips.tooLarge: Choose an MP3 or WAV of 3 MB or less.
clips.title: Recording library
clips.intro: Pre-recorded clips play in order from the shift details. A generic form of address is used, not the employee's name. Extra notes are uploaded separately on the dispatch draft.
clips.hint: Prepare only the clips a real shift needs. Missing clips are listed before publish, including confirmation, cancellation, and filled notices. This mode does not use speech synthesis. Normal call charges still apply. There may be a short pause between clips.
clips.sampleHint: You can adjust the wording. Keep the numbers, units, and keypresses. Dates and times are joined from separate clips, so record them at a consistent pace and volume and trim extra silence from both ends.
clips.siteHint: Include the site name and the full address. If either changes, map the clip again.
clips.yearHint: A year is played as four digits, for example two, zero, two, eight, then “year”. English does not add “year”.
clips.upload: Upload a recording for this clip
clips.uploadHint: MP3 and PCM 16-bit WAV are supported, up to 3 MB each. Mapping takes effect when you save settings at the top of the page. Jobs already sent keep their original recordings.
clips.noSites: This category has no sites yet. Create a site first.
clips.needClips: You can play this notice in sequence after every clip is in place.
clips.playFailed: Could not play the recording. Check the file or try the preview again.
clips.loadFailed: The recording failed to load. Refresh and try again.
clips.complete: Recordings are complete, including follow-up notices.
clips.preparing: Preparing audio automatically. You can preview it when this finishes.
clips.fallbackVoice: If a person cannot use WhatsApp, confirmation, cancellation, or filled notices may use a phone call, so those recordings are needed too.
clips.sayIntro: The call reads this site, date, time, and keypress prompts in the employee's language. You do not upload a recording.
clips.sayKeys: Hong Kong time is used. Press 1 to accept, 2 to decline, and 9 to hear it again.
clips.libraryIntro: Your own recordings. The full date and time are played in Hong Kong time, with a generic form of address. Press 1 to accept, 2 to decline, and 9 to hear it again.
clips.libraryHint: Shared clips are mapped under Channel settings → Phone audio. The preview below does not place a call.
clips.needCandidates: The language recordings you need are listed after you add candidates.
voice.prepareFailed: Could not prepare the audio. Try again.
voice.prepareTimeout: Audio is still being prepared. Try again shortly.
